pages.title: §lPity Mechanism
pages.text: The pity system ensures players don't get stuck with low-tier affixes forever.$(br2)Each time you obtain a Tier 1 or Tier 2 affix, 1 'luck point' is accumulated on the item.$(br)Accumulated luck increases the chance of obtaining a high-tier affix on the next roll.

Luck resets when you obtain a Tier 3 or higher affix.$(br2)Using high-quality enchanting materials (like Nether Stars) increases luck point gain per roll and raises the reset threshold, making high-tier affixes appear more frequently.
